RStudio addin: paste paths from the clipboard

Source: R/addins.R
addin_paste_path.Rd

Reads Windows paths from the clipboard, replaces backslashes with forward slashes, and inserts them at the cursor: one path as a quoted R string, several (one per line, as Copy as path gives them for several files) as a c(...) vector. Quotes around a copied path are dropped, so the explorer's Copy as path pastes as "C:/data/jan.csv", not ""C:/data/jan.csv"".

Usage

addin_paste_path()

See also

addin_text_to_vector() for a list already in the file.
